children: CytoDyn Inc. reported a consolidated net loss of $(42.7M) for fiscal 2026, with diluted loss per share of $(0.03), versus a $3.7M net income and essentially $0 EPS in fiscal 2025; the company cited limited cash of $11.9M at May 31, 2026 and said working capital and accumulated deficits raise substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
Net income: $(42.7M) consolidated net loss for FY 2026, compared with $3.7M net income in FY 2025 (swing of $46.4M YoY).
Diluted EPS: $(0.03) for FY 2026, $0.00 for FY 2025.
Cash: $11.9M cash and cash equivalents at May 31, 2026 (flat YoY); company notes working capital deficit and accumulated deficit raise substantial doubt about going concern.
Clinical development: Completed enrollment and dosed the first patient in the Phase 2 colorectal cancer (CLOVER) study and is expanding solid-tumor oncology programs.
Partnerships and operations: Engaged Syneos as CRO, added academic collaborators and an AI drug‑discovery partner to advance long‑acting molecule work and accelerate trials.
Clinical data momentum: Reported encouraging historical responses in metastatic CRC and mTNBC and PD‑L1 findings that support combination immunotherapy strategies.
Operational buildout: Hired key staff, expanded patent filings and completed strategic financings to support ongoing trials and program advancement.
